verdict.rationale: LanceDB's docs explicitly document ANN vector search with top-k retrieval, configurable distance metrics (e.g., hamming for binary vectors, plus standard metrics implied by index config), exact/exhaustive flat scan option, multi-vector query support, and distance thresholding for near-duplicate detection. Quantization (PQ/RQ/SQ) and vector index build docs further confirm a mature ANN implementation, and community evidence corroborates real-world embeddable vector search use with predicate pushdown filtering. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark or hands-on validation of recall/accuracy across different distance metrics, and no explicit enumeration of all supported metrics (e.g., cosine, L2, dot) in one place.
